about: Findings that `bun run fuzz:ci` (seeds 1..500) still produces on master; test/fuzz/README.md explains the gate. Each entry names the open issue or PR that tracks it and lists the seeds it fires on. An entry matches a finding on status, errorName, the file of its top library frame and a message prefix, and only covers the seeds it lists: the same error on any other seed counts as new. Delete an entry when its fix lands; the run prints a note once an entry or some of its seeds stop reproducing.

findings.example: a $ref cycle with no concrete base case, e.g. a definition that is only a $ref to itself, kept alive by unreachableDefinitions or reached through another $ref: {"definitions": {"A": {"$ref": "#/definitions/A"}}} with {unreachableDefinitions: true}. Since PR 804 this is rejected on purpose with a ReferenceError naming the $ref, so it is expected behaviour rather than a bug; the entry stays until the generator learns not to emit such cycles or the harness treats this error as expected.
